source: Parse PDF as image instead of text. Automatically falls back to text processing for non-vision models.
target: 将 PDF 作为图片解析。模型不支持识图时，自动改用文本处理。
将 PDF 作为图片解析

source: Images larger than this will be resized before sending to server. Set to 0 to disable.
target: 超过此分辨率的图片会在发送前缩小。设为 0 可关闭。
图片最大分辨率（百万像素）

source: Display generation statistics (tokens/second, token count, duration) below each assistant message.
target: 在每条助手消息下方显示生成统计，包括每秒 token 数、token 总数和耗时。

source: Display per-turn statistics (tokens, duration) under each turn in agentic responses. Shown only when "Show message generation statistics" is enabled.
target: 在智能体回复的每一轮下方显示 token 数与耗时。仅在启用“显示消息生成统计”时显示。

source: Show statistics for individual agentic turns
target: 显示智能体每一轮的统计

source: Expand thought process by default when generating messages.
target: 生成消息时默认展开思考过程。

source: Automatically expand tool call details while executing and keep them expanded after completion.
target: 执行工具时自动展开调用详情，完成后保持展开。
始终显示工具调用内容

source: Render user messages using markdown formatting in the chat. Turn this off to keep a message exactly as typed; @-mention badges show either way.
target: 以 Markdown 格式显示用户消息。关闭后保留输入原貌；两种情况下均显示 @ 引用标记。
以 Markdown 显示用户消息

source: Render the reasoning/thinking block content as formatted Markdown instead of plain text.
target: 以 Markdown 格式显示推理和思考内容。
以 Markdown 显示思考内容

source: Always display code blocks at their full natural height, overriding any height limits.
target: 始终按完整内容高度显示代码块，不限制高度。

source: Disable automatic scrolling while messages stream so you can control the viewport position manually.
target: 流式生成消息时关闭自动滚动，由您手动控制阅读位置。

source: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop instead of auto-hiding it.
target: 在桌面端始终显示侧栏。

source: Show open chats as browser-style tabs above the conversation, one per open chat. When disabled, only one chat is shown at a time.
target: 在对话上方以标签页显示已打开的对话。关闭后每次仅显示一个对话。

source: Display full raw model identifiers (e.g. "ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q8_0") instead of parsed names with badges.
target: 显示完整的模型标识（例如“ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q8_0”），不使用解析后的名称与标记。

source: Display quantization badges (e.g. Q8_0, Q4_K_M) next to model names throughout the interface.
target: 在模型名称旁显示量化标记，例如 Q8_0、Q4_K_M。

source: Display model tags (e.g. "vision", "reasoning") next to model names throughout the interface.
target: 在模型名称旁显示能力标签，例如“识图”“推理”。

source: Display the organization name in the model selector trigger button.
target: 在模型选择按钮上显示组织名称。

source: Show organization name in model selector trigger
target: 在模型选择按钮上显示组织名称

source: Display the current build version in the bottom-right corner of the interface.
target: 在界面右下角显示当前构建版本。

source: Display the full file system path inside file and folder @-mention badges instead of just the file or folder name.
target: 在文件和文件夹的 @ 引用标记中显示完整路径。
在引用中显示完整路径

source: Configure MCP servers as a JSON list. Use the form in the MCP Client settings section to edit.
target: 以 JSON 列表配置 MCP 服务器。可在 MCP 客户端设置中通过表单编辑。

source: Maximum number of tool execution cycles before stopping (prevents infinite loops).
target: 工具执行循环的最大次数，达到后停止，以避免无限循环。

source: Timeout for individual MCP tool calls.
target: 单次 MCP 工具调用的超时时间。

source: How many directory levels below the working directory the @-mention file search descends. Larger values surface deeply nested files but take longer on large trees.
target: @ 引用文件搜索从工作目录向下搜索的层数。增大可发现更深层文件，但大型目录的搜索耗时会增加。

source: Controls the randomness of the generated text by affecting the probability distribution of the output tokens. Higher = more random, lower = more focused.
target: 通过调整输出 token 的概率分布控制文本随机性。数值越高越随机，越低越集中。

source: Addon for the temperature sampler. The added value to the range of dynamic temperature, which adjusts probabilities by entropy of tokens.
target: 温度采样器的附加设置。指定动态温度的变化范围，根据 token 熵调整概率。

source: Addon for the temperature sampler. Smoothes out the probability redistribution based on the most probable token.
target: 温度采样器的附加设置。根据最高概率 token 平滑概率的重新分配。
仅保留概率最高的 K 个 token。

source: Limits tokens to those that together have a cumulative probability of at least p
target: 保留累计概率至少达到 P 的候选 token。

source: Limits tokens based on the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token.
target: 按相对于最高概率 token 的最低概率阈值筛选候选 token。

source: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the chance of cutting tokens at all. 0 disables XTC.
target: XTC 采样器会排除高概率 token；此参数控制是否执行排除的概率。设为 0 可关闭 XTC。

source: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the token probability that is required to cut that token.
target: XTC 采样器会排除高概率 token；此参数指定 token 被排除所需达到的概率。

source: Sorts and limits tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
target: 根据对数概率与熵的差异，对候选 token 排序并筛选。

source: The maximum number of token per output. Use -1 for infinite (no limit).
target: 每次输出的最大 token 数。设为 -1 表示不限。

source: The order at which samplers are applied, in simplified way. Default is "top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;temperature": top_k->typ_p->top_p->min_p->temperature
target: 采样器的应用顺序。默认值为“top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;temperature”，即依次执行 top_k、typ_p、top_p、min_p、temperature。

source: Enable backend-based samplers. When enabled, supported samplers run on the accelerator backend for faster sampling.
target: 启用后，受支持的采样器将在加速器后端运行，以加快采样。

source: Last n tokens to consider for penalizing repetition
target: 计算重复惩罚时考虑最近的 N 个 token。
重复惩罚回溯 token 数

source: Controls the repetition of token sequences in the generated text
target: 控制生成文本中 token 序列的重复程度。

source: Limits tokens based on whether they appear in the output or not.
target: 根据 token 是否已在输出中出现施加惩罚。

source: Limits tokens based on how often they appear in the output.
target: 根据 token 在输出中出现的频率施加惩罚。

source: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling multiplier.
target: DRY 采样可减少长上下文中的文本重复。此参数设置 DRY 采样乘数。

source: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling base value.
target: DRY 采样可减少长上下文中的文本重复。此参数设置 DRY 采样基数。

source: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the allowed length for DRY sampling.
target: DRY 采样可减少长上下文中的文本重复。此参数设置允许重复的长度。

source: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets DRY penalty for the last n tokens.
target: DRY 采样可减少长上下文中的文本重复。此参数指定对最近 N 个 token 应用 DRY 惩罚。
DRY 惩罚回溯 token 数

source: After each response, re-submit the conversation to pre-fill the server KV cache. Makes the next turn faster since the prompt is already encoded while you read the response.
target: 每次回复后重新提交对话以预填充服务器 KV 缓存。在您阅读回复时提前编码提示词，以加快下一轮。
回复后预填充 KV 缓存

source: Send reasoning_format=none so the server returns thinking tokens inline instead of extracting them into a separate field.
target: 发送 reasoning_format=none，使服务器将思考 token 直接放入正文，不提取到独立字段。

source: Strip thinking from previous messages before sending. When off, thinking is sent back via the reasoning_content field so the model sees its own chain-of-thought across turns.
target: 发送前移除历史消息中的思考内容。关闭后，通过 reasoning_content 字段回传思考内容，供模型在后续轮次参考。
从上下文中排除推理内容

source: Show toggle button to display messages as plain text instead of Markdown-formatted content
target: 显示切换按钮，以纯文本查看消息。

source: Expose a run_javascript tool to the model. Code runs in a Web Worker inside a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin, isolated from the WebUI and its API, with a hard timeout.
target: 向模型提供 run_javascript 工具。代码在沙盒 iframe 的 Web Worker 中执行，与网页界面及其 API 隔离，并设有严格超时。

source: Pre-load nerdamer in the sandbox for symbolic computation: simplify, diff, integrate, solve, and more. Requires "JavaScript sandbox tool" to be enabled.
target: 在沙盒中预加载 nerdamer，支持化简、求导、积分、求解等符号计算。需要启用“JavaScript 沙盒工具”。

source: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. Must be valid JSON format.
target: 发送给 API 的自定义参数，必须为有效的 JSON。

source: CSS injected into the page at runtime. Set it here, or ship it server side via the --ui-config customCss field.
target: 运行时注入页面的 CSS。可在此设置，也可通过服务器 --ui-config 的 customCss 字段提供。
设置数据无效：缺少 config 配置
图片需要支持识图的模型

source: Audio files require an audio-capable model
target: 音频文件需要支持音频的模型

source: Video files require a video-capable model
target: 视频文件需要支持视频的模型
